summary: Closure review: the manuscript honestly reports an artifact‑grounded ceiling outcome and implements the substantive methodological diagnosis. Of the three prior required revisions, one (explicit design‑ceiling sentence in Abstract/Methods) is addressed; two remain unresolved: (1) aggregated difficulty‑level summary counts/percentages from the archived task_manifest and (2) explicit in‑manuscript bibliographic entries (the paper still points readers to an 'archived verified bibliography'). These two unresolved items are resolvable from the supplied artifacts. No new critical scientific problems were introduced by the revision.
required_revisions: Include an aggregated difficulty summary table (counts and percentages per difficulty level: medium / hard / very_hard) computed from execution/task_manifest.jsonl (the archived per‑task difficulty labels). Place the table and a 1–2 sentence caption in Results (or an Appendix section inside pages 1–5). Report exact counts and percentages and reference the manifest artifact path or hash in the caption for auditors.

Replace the current placeholder reference to an 'archived verified bibliography' with explicit full bibliographic entries for the nearest prior works cited in Related Work (use the verified citation records already archived in the artifact bundle). Provide standard in‑manuscript citations and a References list (IEEE style) containing those entries; the archived citation records in the artifact bundle provide the metadata needed.
optional_revisions: (Optional) Add the single‑row execution accounting summary table (planned episodes, completed episodes, model_calls_used, complete_pairs, repairs_applied) drawn from analysis/condition_summary.csv to improve readability.

(Optional) Briefly (1–2 sentences) state the pre‑lock rationale for selecting shared_initial_generation and the single deterministic validator, or explicitly note that the choice was made to isolate validator acceptance on identical generator outputs, citing the preregistration artifact.

(Optional) If space permits, include one representative worked example (one task manifest entry + validator_trace excerpt) to illustrate how a shared candidate accepted by the deterministic validator yields identical outcomes; use an archived example pair (e.g., task-000001) and include it compactly.
